Thanks —

Hi Samir — thanks for the note. Short answers here so you have context before the call:

- Tenant-scoped KV cache: yes — Redwood supports per-tenant prefixing for KV cache so you can keep cached states isolated by customer/organization. We can also provide a policy to evict keys after N minutes if you have short-lived sessions.
- Cost estimate for 200–400 token median: based on your volume bucket shared in the signup form, a rough ballpark is ~0.8–1.6¢ per request with standard batching and our recommended 8-bit quant profile. We’ll run a small sample job during the POC to firm this up.

I’m available for a 30-min demo May 11 at 2:00pm (PST) — booked that tentatively in case you prefer the deeper walkthrough. If you want to start with a micro-slot, Tessa will coordinate.

I’ve attached a short demo agenda and a preliminary mutual_action_plan.pdf with milestone steps we typically use for trial pilots. If it helps, I can also request priority provisioning for a dedicated cache pool for your POC (we’ll cover the provisioning in the MAP).

Cheers,
Monica
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
